CustomField.description: The individual identification code under Art. 20 Abs. 1 Satz 2 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1804. Mandatory per charge point for the THG filing (Bekanntmachung BAnz AT 30.06.2026 B9) but only optional in the BNetzA register - and the regulator's own example omits the E segment the metrology-quota authority requires. Follow DIN SPEC 91286 and keep the E: DE*ABC*E12345678.
CustomField.label: EVSE-ID
